`workbook.xlsx` is an entirely synthetic, minimal workbook generated by
`tests/workbook_fixtures.py`. It contains two sheets with fake order and email
values for regression tests and the packaged executable self-test.

`calamine-base.xls`, `calamine-base.xlsb`, and `calamine-base.ods` are synthetic
type/worksheet fixtures from python-calamine, revision
`4a2b0679f5af70a5d1b70d7f8b713d6b6977e534`:
https://github.com/dimastbk/python-calamine/tree/4a2b0679f5af70a5d1b70d7f8b713d6b6977e534/tests/data

Their MIT license is retained in `calamine-LICENSE`. These files are used only
by regression tests; they are not bundled in the application.
